_note: Historical names that refer to the same team, and names that look related but are NOT. A first, deliberately small down-payment on DESIGN.md §8.4.3 — enough to stop season aggregates being wrong, not an attempt to solve identity across all years.
_why: Season titles are aggregated by winner name, so a team that renamed mid-season loses the titles it won under its old name. TNC won China Top 2017 as 'TNC Pro Team' and appeared at TI8 as 'TNC Predator'; without this, their row read zero.
_rule: An alias asserts the SAME TEAM under a different name. A B-team or secondary roster is a different team and belongs in `distinct`, never here.

source.note: Confirmed by the archive's owner, who followed the scene live: 'TNC Pro Team rebranded to TNC Predator, Tiger was their B-team.'

corroboration.note: This project's own GosuGamers set brackets the changeover without explaining it: 'TnC' in headlines through 2018-03-07, 'TNC Predator' from 2018-04-01.

source.note: Confirmed by the archive's owner: 'Tiger was their B-team.'
